summary: Full E2E verification of new Product Cost Management feature on PREVIEW. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases pass + 26/26 regression (total 32/32). Added 2 extra E2E tests (webhook enrichment + SKU-first precedence) — both pass. Frontend: /product-costs page renders fully for a new user with all required testids; full add → edit → delete → tab-switch → recompute flow works; SKU input is disabled in edit mode; dashboard alert banner appears when missing_product_cost_count > 0 with correct Arabic text and link to /product-costs. No horizontal overflow at 1280 or 390. All merchant acceptance criteria met — safe to deploy.

critical_code_review_comments: product_costs.py is ~530 lines — borderline acceptable but consider splitting compute_order_cost helper into a dedicated cost_lookup module if the matcher logic grows (more match strategies, fuzzy match, etc).
Consider returning a stronger validation error (422 with Arabic detail) instead of generic 400 on Excel imports with malformed numeric values (currently relies on pandas coercion).
The dashboard banner correctly links to /product-costs; ensure the wording 'صافي الربح غير دقيق' remains consistent if/when localisation strings are extracted to i18n.
Webhook ingestion enrichment runs synchronously inside the request — fine for current volume but consider background task / queue for high-throughput merchants.
